# Vilebone wrath

Effects: +20% Health regen, +40% Stamina regen, Slightly weak (+25%) vs Blunt, Slash and Pierce, +20% Blunt, +20% Pierce

# Introduction

Vilebone Wrath is a status effect granted by wearing all three pieces of the Vilebone Set.
It gives:
• +20% Health regeneration
• +40% Stamina regeneration
• Slightly weak (+25% damage taken) vs Blunt, Slash and Pierce
• +20% Blunt damage
• +20% Pierce damage

Categorias: Effects
